title: FactorMiner: A Self-Evolving Agent with Skills and Experience Memory for Financial Alpha Discovery
selection_reason: The current v2 paper releases all 110 admitted formulas and identifies a Top-40 factor combination with weights and signs determined on the training year. The IC-weighted combination is the strongest simple ensemble in the main table and the authors state that simple ensembles capture most of FactorMiner's exploitable predictive power. It was selected before its monthly JKP result was computed.

paper_headline.selection: Top 40 selected on CSI500 in 2024 by absolute mean Spearman IC
paper_headline.combination: IC-weighted factor combination with signs and weights fixed on 2024
paper_headline.test: 2025 across CSI500, CSI1000, CSI300, and Crypto

formula_evidence.accessible_interpreter_role: declared replacement semantics for the exact printed formulas; not author-native result evidence

fixed_learning_policy.selection: rank all 110 factors by absolute mean monthly cross-sectional Spearman IC over the first 12 formation months; deterministic factor-ID tie break; keep 40
fixed_learning_policy.direction: sign of each selected factor's mean training IC
fixed_learning_policy.weight: absolute mean training IC divided by the sum across the selected 40
fixed_learning_policy.signal_standardization: within-month percentile rank centered to [-1,1]; missing factor values contribute zero without weight renormalization
fixed_learning_policy.out_of_sample: selection, signs, and weights remain fixed for every later formation month
fixed_learning_policy.guard: The first 12 months are cash and training outcomes never enter their own strategy returns.

jkp_mapping.$open: abs(prc)/(1+ret) when ret>-1; prior-close-implied proxy because JKP has no monthly open
jkp_mapping.$vwap: dolvol/tvol where both are positive; monthly dollar-volume/share-volume proxy
jkp_mapping.period_translation: Every printed integer lookback is retained exactly and interpreted as monthly observations.
jkp_mapping.universe: largest 1,000 eligible U.S. stocks by formation-date market equity each month
jkp_mapping.label: next-month return, used only by the first-12-month selection rule

portfolio_adapter.reason: The paper reports predictive IC/ICIR but no holdings or investable portfolio rule.
portfolio_adapter.rule: common value-weighted long/short deciles from the frozen combined score

full_system_not_reproduced: The Gemini 3.0 Flash Ralph Loop, prompts, memory states, candidates, admission trajectory, and exact model calls.
The unreleased author-native 60+ operator runtime; an explicitly unaffiliated interpreter supplies semantics.
The 10-minute A-share/Binance panels, point-in-time constituents, and 2024/2025 arrays.
The exact reported IC/ICIR or the claimed 40-worker GPU/C backend.
An author-specified portfolio and trading return, because the paper reports only predictive scores.
A pristine confirmatory test; prior project and JKP outcomes were already visible.
outcome_selection_guard: Do not change the 110 formulas, first-12-month Top-40 selection, IC weighting, interpreter, mappings, direction policy, portfolio, or costs after observing the JKP result. A negative or benchmark-explained result closes the milestone.
